headline: Chile’s Centinela Workers Back Agreement
deck: A vote approved an agreement at the Chilean copper mine while the company said production remained according to plan.
body: At Antofagasta Minerals’ Centinela copper mine in Chile, the Minera Esperanza and Distrito Centinela unions began a strike involving 709 workers on October 7, according to Shanghai Metals Market. [E1]

Workers who voted backed the agreement by 94.49%, according to the communiqué, in a ballot with 97.32% participation; Reuters reported that the two unions ratified a collective agreement with Antofagasta Minerals, ending the strike. [E2][E4]
The company said it had maintained production according to plan and in full compliance with the law. [E3]

evidence_box.fragment: Two unions at Antofagasta Minerals’ Centinela copper mine in Chile — Minera Esperanza and Distrito Centinela — launched a strike on October 7, involving 709 workers, or around 22% of the mine’s direct workforce.
